On 10 November 2024, World Athletics announced the qualification system for the championships.[10] The top 16 teams in each event at the 2024 Summer Olympic Games qualify for entry to the championships.
The host country China will enter with one team in each event, regardless of any entry conditions.
The remaining teams (up to 32 in total per event) will be determined through the top lists in the qualification period (1 January 2024 to 13 April 2025).
